# test/logos/run/wasm_loop_preempt.lgo is build-tagged js && wasm, so
# testdir skips it on every host; this script is its committed runner.
# A logos build for js/wasm defaults GOEXPERIMENT to include
# preemptibleloops and injects -d=logosloopstride=4096
# (work/logos_stride.go), the same flags the fixture's // run line
# carries, so a plain logos build reproduces the testdir invocation.
# The wasm binary then runs under the tree's node wrapper and must
# print exactly the fixture's .out verdict.

[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/wasm_loop_preempt.lgo preempt/main.lgo

cd preempt
logos build -o ../preempt.wasm .
cd ..

exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec preempt.wasm
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/wasm_loop_preempt.out
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=

-- preempt/go.mod --
module example.com/wasmpreempt

go 1.27
